description: Create a new digital gift (Pookie). Returns the gift object including its id and slug. Required: recipientName. Optional: occasion (e.g. birthday, anniversary, graduation), vibe (e.g. romantic, funny, heartfelt), template, tier.

occasion.description: The occasion for the gift, e.g. birthday, anniversary, graduation, just-because.

recipientName.description: The name of the person receiving the gift.

template.description: The visual template ID to use for this gift.

tier.description: The tier level of the gift, e.g. free, premium.

vibe.description: The emotional tone of the gift, e.g. romantic, funny, heartfelt, playful.

name: pookie_create
